segments.title: Cold Open & Headlines: Oregon Earthquake, Rogan-Hinchcliffe, Geography Lesson
segments.notes: Case and Pepito open with a debate tease, then cover a 6.1 magnitude Oregon coast earthquake, Joe Rogan's claim he warned Tony Hinchcliffe off the Puerto Rico joke, and an impromptu U.S. map geography correction.

segments.title: Trump V 2 Rogans: Double Rogan, Floral Coat, Turtle Art Theory, Ooze Housing Policy
segments.notes: Case performs a two-voice parody interview with Donald Trump and Joe Rogan; topics include tort/turtle law reform, solving homelessness with mutagenic ooze half-shells, a Jurassic Park musical without music, ninja aliens from the earth's core, and incinerating the opposing political team.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Garf Rates Viral Videos — Barkley, Fragrance Jesus, Juicy Pussy Bread, Karate Rap, Bear Wrestling
segments.notes: Garf hosts the viral desk: Charles Barkley singing, Jeremy Fragrance opening his heart with a key after his father's death, 'juicy pussy' bread linguistic debate, 1986 Samurai Studios karate rap (still operating as web designers), and a sportsmanlike bear wrestling match.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Candy Corn vs. Candy Canes — $90k Gambling Debt, Communist Insults, Play-Doh Breath
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Halloween vs. Christmas candy; Munch revives a $9,000 gambling debt from the 24-hour stream (now $90k with shark interest), Crum claims corn-based ballistic superiority, and breath insults escalate to Play-Doh scatology.

segments.title: Post-Show Wrap: Satellite Rooms, Cord Management, Democratic Anchor Vote, Raid to Dink Sauce
segments.notes: Case closes while Peter Gibbon lobbies for lead anchor from a satellite room; Pepito proposes taping cords and money to walls; chat votes 'Case in a fancy hat' via exclamation-point democracy; raid sent to Dink Sauce.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Questions his own dog identity, senses void leakage from the Rogan segment, and suggests taping cords and money to walls.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through studio eating a two-hour-old egg with hot sauce, triggers theme music, and is referenced for potential Thanksgiving parade hosting.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts the news desk, discusses unified thought-action philosophy, peeing on the people pile, and Oregon geography.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends candy corn as corn-based American ballistic superiority, denies $9k gambling debt to Munch, and claims centrist 'crumbiness' ideology.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Champions candy canes as Christmas visual lexicon, revives $9k gambling debt (now $90k with interest), and attacks Crum's breath as Play-Doh scatology.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Emerges from a satellite room to lobby for lead anchor, claims six satellite rooms exist, and watches the broadcast from inside the walls.

storylines.beat: [01:24:24] Munch revives a $9,000 gambling debt from the 24-hour stream, compounds it to $90,000 with 'shark loan interest,' and frames it as Crum swimming with sharks.

lore_notes.fact: Experiences identity uncertainty about being a dog during the cold open.
Wears a fancy hat for the final segment and wins the chat's exclamation-point democratic vote for lead anchor.
Reveals the existence of six satellite rooms and broadcasts from one room over while lobbying for lead anchor.
Allegedly owes Munch $9,000 from the 24-hour stream, now compounded to $90,000 with shark-loan interest.
Thanksgiving Day Parade stream is tentatively planned, contingent on Kendall's participation.
Renterton stream with Mayor Godzilla and zombie apocalypse storyline targeted for Friday after 5 PM on Patreon.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with an Oregon earthquake and a Joe Rogan clip before launching into a dual-voice Trump/Rogan parody that pierces the void and leaks darkness into the studio. Garf hosts a transcendent Amongst the Web featuring fragrance Jesus, juicy pussy bread, and the immortal 1986 karate rap. Munch and Crum debate candy corn versus candy canes while litigating a $90,000 shark-interest gambling debt, and Peter Gibbon stages a coup from the satellite rooms as chat votes Case in a fancy hat to remain lead anchor.
